about: The batch plan runner.py times, for gpt-oss-20b (BF16) on one A100 80GB. Written by generate_batches.py, which explains the design: edit that and rerun it instead of editing this file. Each batch lists one length per request: prompt tokens for prefill, tokens already in the KV cache for decode. A hybrid batch is a [prefill, decode] pair of such lists. The first 618 prefill, 565 decode and 448 hybrid batches are the plan of results/gptoss-clean-20261028.
